subject.title: fix(agents): expose fs discovery tools to codex

question: Should existing `group:fs` allowlists automatically grant `grep`, `find`, and `ls`, including directory enumeration and content search, on upgrade?
rationale: The patch is intentionally coherent, but it changes the capability granted by an already documented policy group and crosses the sandbox filesystem disclosure boundary; that product/security contract cannot be chosen safely by automation.

options.title: Approve the broader group
options.body: Accept discovery as part of the existing filesystem group, rebase the PR, and retain the sandbox-specific regression proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the current group contract
options.body: Preserve existing `group:fs` semantics and design a separately named opt-in discovery capability for listing and search.

recommendation.title: Approve the broader group
recommendation.body: Accept discovery as part of the existing filesystem group, rebase the PR, and retain the sandbox-specific regression proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account was explicitly routed into the earlier review that identified the same compatibility and sandbox-boundary decision.
